# Nudges

[@Garbinsky_2020] uncovers that people under save because they have positive illusion of financial responsibility (i.e., they thought they are financially more responsible than the average).

[@Mrkva_2021] found that choice architecture influences inequities across people. More specifically, people with the following dimensions enjoy the most benefit from nudges:

-   Low socioeconomic status (SES)
-   Low numerical ability
-   Low knowledge

Hence, we should use nudges to reduce SES disparities.
